context_notes: Phase 69 was fully planned (fable model), executed (2 plans, 5 tasks, all green), but UAT revealed sync group stutter that could not be attributed to our changes vs. pre-existing. After reverting ALL changes (Rust + Perl) and testing old binary, the same stutter appeared — suggesting it was always there or caused by CDN connection state after ~10 rapid LMS restarts. Session ended by reverting main to 035c3a9 and redeploying old binary.
